messages:
ted: Customer CT-11021 reports they were billed provisional + final when a streaming request failed over to another region. Small thread: why are both showing?

mia: Likely ledger keyed by route. Fallback wrote provisional then commit on new route created confirmed row.

jordan: Quick UX mitigation: hide provisional rows from hosted billing summary and add admin toggle. Dedicated keeps current real-time view.

naiya: Backend fix: change provisional uniqueness to ignore route unless client sends attempt_id. If attempt_id present -> treat as separate attempt.

ted: Telemetry: emit token.prov.write, token.prov.reconcile, token.commit.apply, token.adjustment.emit with tags route+attempt_id so analytics can find reconciliations.

mia: Rollout: 1) hide provisional in hosted UI (fast), 2) add telemetry + dashboard, 3) DB migration + reconcile job (canary -> full), 4) CS note + Dedicated opt-out flag.

jordan: I'll draft the migration PR. naiYa, can you mock the UI toggle and hover copy?

ops-bot: Created INF-6012 and linked CT-11021.

ted: Thanks — keep the canary under watch and alert if provisional/confirmed ratio spikes.
